label: Grocery-store wine sales under an ordinary retail license
definition: Whether state law lets an ordinary grocery or food store, holding the retail license such stores normally hold, sell wine for off-premises consumption. Special channels (a state-contract agency inside a store, a separate licensed premises) are 'conditional_or_special_channel'.
notes: Where the permission applies only in localities that opt in, the value is 'authorized_local_option' and local take-up goes in grocery_wine_local_adoption_share.

label: Grocery-store beer sales under an ordinary retail license
definition: Whether state law lets an ordinary grocery or food store sell beer, as the state defines beer, for off-premises consumption.
notes: The state's own beer definition (strength ceiling) is a separate dimension: beer_definition_max_alcohol.

label: Grocery-store spirits sales under an ordinary retail license
definition: Whether state law lets an ordinary grocery or food store sell distilled spirits for off-premises consumption.

label: Convenience-store wine sales under an ordinary retail license
definition: Whether state law lets an ordinary convenience store sell wine for off-premises consumption.

label: Convenience-store beer sales under an ordinary retail license
definition: Whether state law lets an ordinary convenience store sell beer for off-premises consumption.

label: Beer sales in package (liquor) stores
definition: Whether stores licensed to sell spirits and wine for off-premises consumption may also sell beer.

label: Share of state population where grocery wine sales are locally adopted
definition: Share of the state's resident population living in localities that adopted grocery-store wine sales, where state law makes it a local option. Not applicable where the state permission does not depend on local adoption.
notes: Recorded only from a dated list of adopting localities; never estimated.

label: Localities may prohibit retail alcohol sales (local option)
definition: Whether state law lets counties, cities or precincts prohibit some or all retail alcohol sales (dry or partly dry areas).
notes: This is the state permission; which localities used it is dry_population_share.

label: Share of state population in localities that prohibit off-premises sales
definition: Share of resident population in localities where off-premises retail alcohol sales are prohibited by local option, on a stated date.
notes: Recorded only from a dated official list; never estimated.

label: Who sells spirits for off-premises consumption
definition: The retail arrangement for packaged spirits: state-operated stores, state-contract agencies, local-government stores, private licensed retailers, or a mix.

label: Who sells wine for off-premises consumption
definition: The retail arrangement for packaged wine.

label: Who sells beer for off-premises consumption
definition: The retail arrangement for packaged beer.

label: Who wholesales spirits
definition: Whether the state itself is the wholesaler of spirits or private licensed wholesalers are.

label: Who wholesales wine
definition: Whether the state itself is the wholesaler of wine or private licensed wholesalers are.

label: Who wholesales beer
definition: Whether the state itself is the wholesaler of beer or private licensed wholesalers are.

label: State-contract package agencies
definition: Whether private businesses may sell packaged liquor (spirits, wine, heavy beer) under a contract with the state.

label: Beer excise tax per 31-gallon barrel
definition: State excise tax on beer per 31-gallon barrel at the standard rate.
notes: Reduced rates for small brewers are not this dimension.

label: Wine excise tax per gallon (table wine)
definition: State excise tax per gallon on table wine at the lowest standard strength class. Where the state applies a markup instead, see spirits_or_wine_state_markup_pct.

label: Spirits excise tax per gallon
definition: State excise tax per gallon on distilled spirits at the standard rate.

label: State markup on spirits and wine sold by the state
definition: Percentage markup the state applies to the landed cost of spirits (and wine where the state sells it) in control systems.

label: Minimum retail price rule for wine
definition: A rule setting a floor on retail wine prices (for example, no sales below cost plus a markup).

label: Legal ceiling on the strength of 'beer'
definition: The highest alcohol content a product may have and still be 'beer' under state law.

label: Sunday off-premises beer sales
definition: Whether off-premises beer sales are allowed on Sunday under state law.

label: Sunday off-premises wine sales
definition: Whether off-premises wine sales are allowed on Sunday under state law.

label: Sunday off-premises spirits sales
definition: Whether off-premises spirits sales are allowed on Sunday under state law.

label: Off-premises weekday sales hours
definition: The hours during which off-premises sales are allowed on weekdays under state law (local rules may be stricter).

label: Retailer home delivery of wine
definition: Whether licensed retailers may deliver wine to consumers' homes.

label: Direct-to-consumer wine shipping from wineries
definition: Whether wineries (in or out of state) may ship wine directly to consumers in the state.
